note: SHRINK-ONLY ledger of the core/extension border crossings that stood in this tree the day scripts/ci/core-extension-border-gate.mjs landed. Every entry names ONE file and ONE detail, and states in one line why it stands today; there is no wildcard and no shape match. A crossing outside this ledger fails CI immediately. A `pack-shaped-core-domain` entry additionally records the line count of every product file it holds: a NEW file inside it, or a recorded file above its recorded count, is a failure, because the ledger may shrink and never grow. Regenerate with `node scripts/ci/core-extension-border-gate.mjs --write-baseline`, which carries every stated reason forward and refuses to leave a new entry unexplained. See docs/internals/contracts/core-extension-border.md.
